subject: Quick note on SBS Business Systems's website
bodyText:

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and SBS Business Systems stood out.

Cannock office equipment and document systems on Prospect Business Park - and sbssales.co.uk still ships from Microsoft FrontPage 5.0 in windows-1252, still carries a Copyright 2006 Worknet Media mark, and still publishes Fax: 01543.462237 beside sales@sbssales.co.uk. If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
